panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Panel A displays GFAP immunostaining within the tumor tissue, confirming the glial component of the complex cerebellar DNT as per the case report. B: Panel B shows S100 protein staining in the tumor, highlighting the presence of an oligodendroglioma-like cellular component within the DNT. C: Panel C exhibits Synaptophysin positivity, confirming neuronal-specific elements within the DNT tumor as described in the context. D: Panel D shows high Ki-67 proliferation, reflecting the high Ki-67 proliferative index noted in the patient's tumor cellularity.

in_text_mentions: Immunohistochemistry revealed S100 protein expression in the oligodendroglioma-like cellular component, glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) in the astrocytic components, synaptophysin positivity neuron-specific enolase and neurofilament expression in the floating neurons, Ki-67 proliferative index was high in regard to tumor cellularity (Figures 4A-4D, 5A-5C). Based on the morphological finding and the immunohistochemical profile of the cellular components, the diagnosis of complex cerebellar DNT, WHO CNS grade 1, was defined.
